# Validate regression model inputs

<small>Source: [`R/validation.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/validation.R) · Help: `?rvalidateModelInputs`</small>

Ensures that a supplied regression model satisfies the basic assumptions
required by the heteroscedasticity testing infrastructure. The checks
include class validation, successful fitting, availability of finite
residuals, and minimum sample size requirements.

## Usage

```r
rvalidateModelInputs(model, test_name, min_obs = 10, allow_aliased = FALSE)
```

## Arguments

`model`
:   A fitted model object produced by [`stats::lm()`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/lm.html) or
    [`stats::glm()`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/glm.html).

`test_name`
:   A scalar character identifier used in error messages to
    reference the calling test.

`min_obs`
:   Minimum number of observations required for the calling
    procedure. Defaults to `10`.

`allow_aliased`
:   Logical. `FALSE`, the default, refuses a rank-deficient
    fit, whose aliased coefficients are `NA`, with a message that names them;
    `TRUE` accepts it, for a procedure computed on the estimable part of the
    design. A coefficient that is not finite for another reason is refused
    either way.

## Value

Invisibly returns `model` when validation passes.
